critical_rule: A prediction attached to release T is PIT only if prediction value, type, publisher, announcement identity, and prediction as-of timestamp exist, and prediction_asof < official_release_time, or an equally strong documented mechanism proves the prediction was fixed before release.
insufficient: historical prediction value returned today without vintage/as-of evidence
vendor statement that data is historical
a field named forecast or predicted_value by itself
FXMacroData blended/model forecast labelled as consensus
quarterly survey mapped onto a monthly release without a documented pre-release cutoff
acceptable_proof: documented stored_at_generation capture with generated_at < release
retrospective official archive import with dated known-at marker strictly before release

sample_selection_rule.principle: Most recent eligible completed USD event per priority category. Not selected by later FX move.
sample_selection_rule.source_of_identity: FXMacroData announcement_id if no-key announcements work; otherwise official Experiment D most-recent USD clocks S03/S06/S09
